title: Nethander Stead
wikitext:
[[File:Nethander Stead.jpg|thumb|300px|Nethander Stead.]]

The '''Nethander Stead''' is a farm just east of [[Southshore]]. It has been overrun by [[Mudsnout]] [[gnoll]]s, and is the only location that gnolls of this tribe can be found. Giant white mushrooms called [[Mudsnout Blossoms]] grow in its abandoned fields. These mushrooms are of particular interest to [[Apothecary Lydon]] in order to make a deadly brew, [[Elixir of Agony]].
